purpose: Git synchronizes portable intent and encrypted authority; every device rebuilds machine-local state from that intent after proving the same master identity.

portableWorkspace.rule: Contains only machine-independent repository, branch, role, Grammar and contract intent. Absolute paths, observed commits, credentials and runtime state are forbidden.

hydratedWorkspace.rule: Derived independently on each device from portable declarations and the local filesystem.

durableWorktree.rule: The Source repository never tracks the container. Approved product or authority changes are committed by the worktree's own Git repository and branch.

ephemeralWorktree.rule: Agent checkout state is disposable and never portable authority.

referenceCheckout.rule: Read-only clean precedent checkout. Refresh or rebuild it; never author or push from it.

gitmountCheckout.rule: A private operational-data checkout is reconstructed by npm run sync from metadata.json. Its optional credentialEnv and credentialFallbackEnvs resolve only to encrypted runtime files; plaintext tokens, authenticated URLs and the checkout itself never enter Git.

runtimeState.rule: Generated runtime config, virtual environments, PIDs, receipts, caches and absolute routes are local-only.

encryptedDeviceState.rule: Quiesced Docker-volume archives are encrypted to the master age recipient, chunked, checksum-bound and published only as private release assets. Plain archives, Docker volumes and downloaded ciphertext remain local-only; Git tracks only the portable contract.

encryptedAuthority.rule: Ciphertext, recipient metadata, value-free topology and the environment's declaration (readiness/initialization/stacks/environment.schema.json) are portable. The master identity and decrypted twins are never committed.

masterIdentity.rule: Provision out of band on each trusted device. Possession permits decryption but never changes Git tracking rules.

deviceBootstrap: Pull the Source repository and its independent StarCi skills checkout.
Prove the out-of-band master identity without printing its contents.
Validate tracked portable declarations and the Git boundary.
Run workspace-portable.mjs bootstrap --apply to clone absent declared sibling checkouts and hydrate machine-local project-role routes.
Create or verify declared worktrees and clean reference checkouts.
Run npm run sync to decrypt local secret twins and reconstruct declared private gitmounts without per-device GitHub login.
Fetch the latest compatible encrypted device-state release; restore only into absent or explicitly approved replaceable Docker volumes.
Rebuild declared runtime state without a derived search index.
Run Source readiness and prove default search against one exact canonical reference before product work.
